_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.
_bot_token_help: Get one from @BotFather on Telegram: /newbot, then copy the token it gives you.
_chat_id_help: Send any message to your bot, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates in your browser. Look for 'chat':{id:...}
_start_token_help: Token to scan routes from. Options: WPLS, HEX, eHEX, INC, WETH, PLSX, pDAI, DAI, USDC
_amount_in_help: Simulated trade size in human units (e.g. 1000 = 1000 WPLS). The flash swap borrows this amount; you do not need to hold it.
_min_profit_bps_help: Minimum gross profit in basis points of amount_in before alerting. 0 = alert on any net-positive route. 50 = only alert if profit >= 0.5% of trade size.
_min_net_usd_help: Minimum net profit in USD (after estimated gas) before sending a Telegram alert. Default 0.50 filters out hairline-positive ticks. The CSV scan log still records every best route regardless of this floor.
_scan_interval_help: Seconds between scans. 30 is a reasonable default; below 10 may hit RPC rate limits.
_dedup_help: Suppress repeat Telegram alerts for the same route for this many minutes.
_v3_depth_help: V3 tick intervals to read per pool (1-8). Higher = more accurate for large trades but more RPC calls. 4 matches the browser default.
_triangular_help: Also scan triangular 3-hop routes (S -> Y -> Z -> S). Doubles scan time slightly.
_csv_log_help: Append one row per scan to a CSV recording the single best (most-promising) route that scan, even when it loses money after gas. Great for studying near-misses over time. Set false to disable.
_csv_path_help: CSV file to write. Relative paths are resolved inside the server/ folder; absolute paths are used as-is. The file is gitignored by default.
_rpc_help: PulseChain RPC endpoint(s). The scanner uses the first; the keeper tries all of them in order with timeout + retry/backoff. Add one or two backups for resilience.
_keeper_section: ─── v5.1 keeper (automatic execution) — read server/README.md before --live ───
_keeper_enabled_help: Hard global on/off for sending. false = the keeper still detects/simulates but every send is blocked by the guard. Default true (sends still also require the --live flag AND a key).
_executor_help: The deployed ArbExecutor contract the keeper calls execute() on. This is a public contract address, not your wallet.
_poll_help: How often (ms) the keeper polls the chain tip. It only scans when the block advances, so it reacts within one block. 3000 is well under PulseChain's block time; 1000-5000 is reasonable.
_min_profit_usd_help: Minimum simulated net-after-gas USD required to act on a route. Falls back to min_net_usd if unset. Default 0.50.
_max_gas_price_help: Abort a send if the live gas price (gwei) exceeds this cap. null = no cap. PulseChain gwei is large nominally but costs ~\$0.0015/tx; set a sanity ceiling if you like.
_onchain_guard_help: On-chain minProfit is set to this fraction of the simulated edge. 0.9 = the tx reverts (losing only gas) unless >=90% of the expected profit still exists at inclusion. This is the core safety guard against the one-block edge closing.
_tx_deadline_help: Seconds added to now for the execute() deadline param. The tx reverts if not mined within this window.
_gas_limit_buffer_help: Percent added to eth_estimateGas for the send gas limit, to avoid out-of-gas on slight state drift.
_max_trades_help: Kill switch: stop sending after this many trades in a UTC day. Counter resets at UTC midnight.
_max_daily_loss_help: Kill switch: stop sending once cumulative realized loss (reverted-tx gas) in a UTC day reaches this USD. Resets at UTC midnight.
_max_sim_help: Max routes to simulate per block (best-first). The keeper acts on the first that passes; the rest are logged.
_keeper_csv_help: Keeper's own CSV log (separate from the scanner's scan_log.csv). Relative paths resolve inside server/. Gitignored by default.
_keeper_key_help: OPTIONAL fallback key source for --live if KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY is not set: a file containing only the 0x-prefixed private key. This file is gitignored — NEVER commit it. Prefer the env var. Use a DEDICATED low-balance keeper wallet.
